modules.description:
Modules of this host, in order. A later module's single values win
over an earlier one's; the host's own win over all of them.

groups.description: Supplementary groups. Groups the user has beyond these show up in drift.

disk.description: The disk's name in /dev/disk/by-id. Any other disk is refused.

esp.description: Size of the EFI system partition, e.g. 4GiB.

swapfile.description: Size of the swapfile in @swap, e.g. 32GiB. Empty for no swap.

limine.description:
The hand-written part of /boot/limine.conf (globals, extra entries),
relative to the host folder. limine-entry-tool writes the rest.

packages.description:
Packages from the Arch repositories or the AUR. Local packages are not
listed here: a module's pkg/ folder installs its own.

user-services.description: User units to enable for every user (systemctl --global enable).

mode.description:
Mode in octal, like 0440. Default 0644, or 0755 for a file that is
executable in git.

owner.description: Owner of a system file. Default root.

group.description: Group of a system file. Default root.

check.description:
Command run on the new file before it replaces the live one; {} is the
new file's path. Example: visudo -cf {}

then.description: Command run after the file changed.

link.description:
Makes the target a link to this path, relative to the module folder.
For things edited in place, like mpv's config.

additionalProperties.description: FileOptions changes how a file is installed, or declares a link.

files.description:
Options for the files of the module's system/ and home/ folders, and
links. Keys are target paths: /etc/… or ~/…

ignore.description:
Paths that drift never reports, as globs where * also matches /
(/etc/ssl/certs/*).

firewall.description:
Ports to open. Declaring firewall: in any module turns the firewall on,
even with no port.

kde.description:
KDE settings: file, then group (nested groups separated by /), then
key and value, written with kwriteconfig6. Only for files KDE also
writes itself; a file KDE only reads goes in home/.

kde-ignore.description:
KDE keys lodestar kde review never shows, as file/group/key globs
where * also matches /: dolphinrc/MainWindow/*

breeze-exceptions.description:
Breeze window decoration exceptions (breezerc). lodestar numbers the
entries of every module and owns the whole list. Keys as in breezerc:
ExceptionPattern, ExceptionType, HideTitleBar, BorderSize, Mask, Enabled.

window-rules.description:
KWin window rules (kwinrulesrc). lodestar owns the whole file. Keys as
in kwinrulesrc: Description, wmclass, wmclassmatch, desktops, …

name.description: Name shown in System Settings, for a command.

component.description: KDE component of an existing action, e.g. kwin, plasmashell.

action.description: The action's name in kglobalshortcutsrc, e.g. Window Maximize.

keys.description: One key, or a list: Meta+É, Ctrl+Alt+T. Empty to unbind an action.

shortcuts.description:

merge.description: The JSON file with the chosen keys, relative to the module folder.

unless-running.description: Skip while this process runs (it would overwrite the file on exit).

items.description: JSONMerge merges a JSON file of the module into a JSON file of $HOME.

json.description: Keys merged into JSON files that apps rewrite themselves.

run.description: A script in the module folder, or a command (sh syntax) run there.

when.description:
changed (default): when the module's folder changed since the last
run. always: on every apply.

items.description: Hook runs a script during apply.

hooks.description: Scripts run during apply, for what is not a file or a key.

watch.description:

pkg.description:
